text:
jess: quick smoke: ran Mercury11B int4 on longform summarization slice (~1.1k avg tokens). big cost upside (about 3.6x vs fp16) but small referentiality regression observed. posting quick notes.

kai: can you share perf: p95/p99, tok/s, and exact eval config?

jess: p95 430ms (fp16 405ms), p99 900ms. throughput ~205 tok/s. unit cost per 1k tokens: $0.036 int4 vs $0.13 fp16. eval command: `python eval/run_longform.py --seed 42 --metrics referentiality,rouge --slices citations,coref,dialogue`

priya: is the referentiality drop specific to citation-heavy prompts? or also coref chains?

jess: mostly citation-heavy plus some long coref chains. example (redacted):
  gold: "According to Nguyen et al. (2019), the approach guarantees convergence."
  int4: "Nguyen et al. (2019) reported something similar, details unclear."

sam: sounds like attribution vagueness / hallucinated hedging. can priming or retrieval reduce this?

kai: also include nova13b-int6 in next matrix so product sees delta vs our hybrid route.

jess: will add nova13b-int6 and run 10k examples split across slices. ETA EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: scheduled_canary: dedicated canary window tentatively reserved 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC (awaiting sign-off)

priya: for the scorecard capture per-slice delta referentiality, delta rouge, unit cost, p95/p99, top failure modes (with sample ids), and recommended rollback gate. product needs explicit thresholds.

marta: product: cost win is attractive but citation regressions hurt trust. willing to pilot if mitigations (priming, retrieval, internal-beta flag) are in place and we get monitoring on referentiality + sample reviews.

kai: propose rollout block if referentiality drop >3 pts on citation slice OR p99 latency >20% regression for high-context queries.

jess: noted. also will run priming experiments (strong citation prompt) and an AB with caching on/off to measure caching effect. will include model/quant commit hash and eval seed in scorecard (commit a1b2c3d).

priya: ops ask: pre-approve rollback path: immediate traffic shift to nova13b-int6 or fp16 fallback.

sam: ill draft a short rollback runbook and post to #eng-oncall.

jess: thanks all. will update with the full scorecard + sampled failures once runs finish.
